General Remarks.

The land sold during the year amounted to 38,033.46 acres, which realized $365,684.04. The quantity of surrendered

<!-- page 852 -->
land in the hands of the department was approximatively 287,427.18 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian Lands sold, amounted to $372.113.59, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
